auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Sign-ins, changes and actions in this organization, signed and chained.

empty.title: No events yet
empty.description: Actions and decisions appear here as people use agents and flows.

noResults.title: No matching events
noResults.description: Try another search, or clear the filters.

search.label: Search the audit log
search.placeholder: Search by event, person or object

detail.title: Audit entry
detail.integrityHelp: Each entry's signature covers it and the entry before it, so changing or removing any entry breaks every later one.
detail.chained: Chained to the previous entry · position {position}, sealed {sealedAt}
detail.notChainedYet: Joins the chain within about a minute

integrity.sealed: {count, plural, one {# entry sealed} other {# entries sealed}}
integrity.sealing: {count, plural, one {# entry sealing} other {# entries sealing}}

mismatch.title: An audit entry doesn't match its chain
mismatch.description: Contact support with the entry ID. The log stays readable.

export.title: Export audit log
export.description: Download the entries that match the current filters.
export.scope: The export includes every entry that matches the search and filters, with its signature.

personalData.title: This file contains personal data
personalData.description: Names, IP addresses and browser details of the people in the log. Store it securely; the download is recorded in the audit log.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: How actions were checked, what was blocked and what needs attention.

empty.title: No checks yet
empty.description: Actions and decisions appear here as people use agents and flows.

checked.title: How actions were checked
checked.description: Every action an agent or flow tried in this period, by what Guard did with it.

blockedByLimits.label: Blocked by limits
blockedByLimits.help: Stopped by a blocked action or a limit

personalDataHidden.label: Personal data hidden
personalDataHidden.help: Requests where data was masked or blocked

ranOnLocalModels.label: Ran on local models
ranOnLocalModels.help: Data stayed on your network, so the filter did not apply

medianMinutesToApprove.label: Median time to approve
medianMinutesToApprove.help: From request to a person's decision

attention.title: Needs your attention
attention.description: Open items that Guard cannot settle by itself.

kinds.approvals_overdue: {count, plural, one {# approval has} other {# approvals have}} waited longer than the target time
kinds.guardrail_conflict: {count, plural, one {# guardrail conflicts} other {# guardrails conflict}} with another rule
kinds.agent_thresholds_outdated: {count, plural, one {# agent uses} other {# agents use}} thresholds looser than your defaults

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Decisions that need a person are in the approvals queue.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Confidence thresholds and approval settings for the organization.

readOnly.title: You can view these values
readOnly.description: Admins and Owners change the Guard defaults.

thresholds.title: Confidence thresholds
thresholds.description: How sure Guard must be before an action runs without a person.

auto.label: Automatic
auto.help: At or above this confidence the action runs on its own.

review.label: AI double-check
review.help: At or above this a second model reviews the action. Below it a person decides.

thresholds.summary: Automatic at {auto}% and above · AI double-check {review}–{autoBelow}% · Needs a person below {review}%
thresholds.summaryNoCheck: Automatic at {auto}% and above · Needs a person below {auto}%
thresholds.invalid: The double-check threshold must be lower than the automatic one.

impact.title: Impact preview
impact.headline: With these values, {human} of the last {total} actions would have needed a person.
impact.empty: There are no recent actions to preview yet.
impact.invalid: Choose a double-check threshold below the automatic one to see the impact.

approvals.title: Approval settings
approvals.description: What can be approved quickly, when people confirm it is them, and how long approvals may wait.

quick.help: The top-bar popover and bulk approve decide only approvals within this limit. 0 means no money.

stepUp.label: Ask people to confirm it is them above an amount
stepUp.help: Approvals above this amount need a fresh sign-in.

target.help: The queue shows a warning when an approval waits longer.
target.invalid: Enter a time of up to one year.

save.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}

confirm.title: Save the Guard defaults?
confirm.description: Applies to all agents and flows that use defaults.
confirm.reasonRequired: Give a reason for loosening Guard.

loosened.auto: The automatic threshold goes from {from}% to {to}%.
loosened.review: The double-check threshold goes from {from}% to {to}%.
loosened.quickAmount: The quick-approve limit goes from {from} to {to}.
loosened.quickRisk: Quick approve now includes medium-risk actions.
loosened.stepUp: People no longer confirm it is them above {from}.
loosened.stepUpRaised: People confirm it is them only above {to} instead of {from}.

guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.description: Approval rules, limits and blocked actions that apply to your agents and flows.

empty.title: No guardrails yet
empty.description: Add a rule to control what agents may do.

noResults.title: No guardrails match
noResults.description: Try another search, or clear the filters.

typeHelp.approval_rule: A person decides before the action runs.
typeHelp.threshold_override: Asks for more confidence than the defaults for these actions.
typeHelp.action_limit: Business limits, such as a refund amount per action or payments per day.
typeHelp.content_filter: Flags or blocks content in these categories.

guardrails.usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing yet} one {# agent or flow} other {# agents and flows}}

impact.none: No agent or flow uses it yet.

reason.label: Reason
reason.required: Give a reason. It is saved in the audit log.

sheet.addDescription: Choose what the rule does, then which actions it covers.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.typeFixed: A rule keeps its type. Add another rule to use a different one.
sheet.enabledHelp: A rule that is off stays saved but is not checked.

match.title: Which actions
match.actionHelp: A tool, bridge action or category, such as payments.refund.
match.conditionsHelp: Narrow the rule to actions whose input matches.
match.valueHelp: A number, text, true or false. For “is one of”, separate values with commas.

approval.title: Approval
approval.approversHelp: A role means that role and every role above it.
approval.waitsHelp: Without it the approval waits until someone decides or it is canceled.

override.title: Thresholds
override.help: Only values higher than your defaults take effect.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.help: Any agent or flow that tries this action is stopped and the attempt is recorded.

limit.title: Limits
limit.help: Set one or more limits. What happens when one is reached is below.

validation.name: Enter a name
validation.action: Enter the action this rule covers
validation.wait: Enter a wait of up to 30 days
validation.thresholds: The double-check threshold must be lower than the automatic one.

lock.bannerLockedAdmin: Locked by {name} · {reason}. Only Owners can change, turn off or delete this rule.
lock.dialogDescription: Only Owners can change, turn off or delete a locked rule.
lock.reasonHelp: Shown next to the lock and saved in the audit log.
lock.reasonRequired: Give a reason for the lock.

conflict.title: Another rule already blocks this action
conflict.description: “{name}” blocks the same action. You can still save stricter rules.

agent.title: This rule belongs to an agent
agent.description: Agent rules are edited in the agent's Guard tab.

flow.title: This rule belongs to a flow
flow.description: Flow rules are edited in the flow's steps.

data_filters.title: This is a data filter
data_filters.description: Personal-data filters are edited in Data filters.

saveConfirm.title: Save changes to “{name}”?
saveConfirm.description: This makes the rule less strict, so it stops fewer actions than before.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete “{name}”?
deleteConfirm.description: The rule is removed for good. Agents and flows are no longer checked by it.

turnOff.title: Turn off “{name}”?
turnOff.description: Agents and flows stop being checked by this rule.

dataFilters.title: Data filters
dataFilters.description: Which personal data is detected, masked or blocked before it leaves for a cloud model.

readOnly.title: You can view these filters
readOnly.description: Admins and Owners change the data filters.

localModels.title: Local models skip the filter
localModels.description: Data sent to a model on your own network stays there, so the filter does not apply.

actionHelp.detect: Found and recorded, sent as written.
actionHelp.mask: Replaced with a placeholder, such as [EMAIL].

section.title: Personal-data types
section.description: What happens when this data would leave for a cloud model or a search provider.

exceptionDialog.title: Add an exception for {type}
exceptionDialog.description: A team can handle this type differently from the organization. Loosening the filter sends more data to cloud models, so it is recorded with your reason.
exceptionDialog.reasonRequired: Give a reason. It is saved in the audit log.

custom.title: Custom patterns
custom.description: Your own types, found by a pattern such as a customer number.

customDialog.description: A regular expression that finds the data, such as a customer number.
customDialog.label: Name
customDialog.patternHelp: Up to 500 characters. Patterns that could run slowly are refused.

loosen.title: Loosen the filter for {type}?
loosen.description: More of this data reaches cloud models, with less protection.
loosen.reasonRequired: Give a reason. It is saved in the audit log.

removeCustom.title: Delete “{label}”?
removeCustom.description: This data is no longer looked for, and it reaches cloud models as written.

removeException.title: Remove the exception for {target}?
removeException.description: The team follows the organization's action for {type} again, which is less strict.

tryIt.title: Try it
tryIt.description: See what the filter does to a text before it leaves. Nothing is saved or sent.
tryIt.sample: Hi, I'm Maria Lopez. You can email me at maria@example.com or call +14155550132. My card is 4111 1111 1111 1111.
tryIt.empty: Enter some text to see the result.

blocked.title: A real request would be stopped
blocked.description: The text has data of a type that is set to block.
